visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women are seated on a light grey sofa against a plain white wall. The woman on the left wears a brown beret, a beige turtleneck, and blue jeans, while the woman on the right is dressed in a black oversized sweater and blue jeans. They are surrounded by several cardboard shipping boxes and colorful blind box packaging, holding them up toward each other. (2) The scene shifts as they begin to unwrap the contents. They remove silver foil packets from the boxes, their facial expressions showing high excitement and wide smiles. The woman on the right holds a small pink figurine, and they compare their items closely. (3) A close-up shows the back of a yellow product box featuring illustrations of various character designs. The women point at specific characters while talking animatedly. (4) The woman in the hat pulls a larger brown plush-like character head out of a silver bag, holding it high for the camera. Both women are laughing heartily and clapping, displaying the new items in front of the gathered open packaging.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video captures the genuine excitement and social interaction between two friends during a blind box unboxing session for POP MART collectibles. It aims to showcase the thrill of 'hitting' desired characters and sharing that joy with a community of fellow hobbyists.
